summary: Minimal interface for generic AMM swap adapters. Defines a single swap() function. Concrete implementations (e.g., CurveAMMAdapter) wrap a specific DEX. Used by ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy to abstract the token-swap layer.

externalEntryPoints.function: swap(address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint256 amountIn, uint256 minAmountOut) returns (uint256 amountOut)
externalEntryPoints.notes: minAmountOut provides slippage protection. Implementations must pull tokenIn from msg.sender and deliver tokenOut to msg.sender (or a specified receiver). No access control at interface level.
